fullText.simplified:
第4章、悬赏公告

    白林侦探社是上海最有名的侦探社，但很少有人知道这个有名的侦探社其实只有三个人：社长白林，职员包厚安和门卫老何。
    白林三十九岁，包厚安十八岁，老何不知年龄。虽然他说自己四十八岁，但他那满头白发实在无法让人相信。
    桌上放着今天的报纸，一个醒目而奇怪的标题引起了包厚安的注意——“抓藏花，赏千金。”他拿起报纸，仔细读起来。
    原来这是一个悬赏公告。
    发公告的人叫高右年，是上海有名的大商人。公告里说高右年家珍藏的珠宝被一个叫藏花的小偷偷走了，只要有人能帮高右年抓住这个小偷、追回被偷的珠宝，高右年就会给他一千元作为赏金。公告的下面还有一张案发现场的照片，是一个空房间。
    “藏花——有意思的名字。”包厚安说。
    “有兴趣？那去抓住他！一千元可是大奖！”老何吃着饼说。
    包厚安摇头说：“这种事情应该去警察局报警，而不是在报纸上发悬赏公告。”
    老何吃了一口饼，说：“你怎么知道他们没报警？如果警察抓得到，那还要我们侦探社做什么？”
    包厚安没有说话，他看着报纸，不知道在想什么。
    “怎么样，有兴趣了吗？”老何问。
    包厚安点了点头。
    “我就说吧！你看我们这办公楼又旧又破！早就该好好修整一下了！一千元可以做很多事啊！”老何兴奋地说。
    “我有兴趣的不是赏金。”包厚安指着公告下面的照片说：“你看，放珠宝的这个房间只有一个门。小偷偷走了珠宝，但门锁没有被破坏，他是怎么进入房间的呢？”
    老何看了看，说：“小偷拿到了门锁的钥匙？”
    包厚安摇头：“公告里说，门锁只有一把钥匙，钥匙只有高右年才有。他把钥匙放在枕头下面，珠宝被偷走的那个晚上，钥匙一直在枕头下面。”
    “那小偷是怎么做到的？”老何好奇地问。
    包厚安说：“只有两种可能，一种是小偷从枕头下面拿到了钥匙，偷走珠宝后又还了回来，高右年睡着了，没有发现钥匙被拿走过。”
    “有道理，但既然已经拿到珠宝了，为什么还要还钥匙呢？”老何问。
    “是的，这是有些奇怪，所以我想可能还有第二种情况。”
    “什么情况？”
    “公告里说的不是真的。”
    “你的意思是高右年说谎了？他为什么要说谎？”老何有点儿不敢相信。
    “我也不知道，这个问题只有高右年才能回答。”

第4章、懸賞公告

    白林偵探社是上海最有名的偵探社，但很少有人知道這個有名的偵探社其實只有三個人：社長白林，職員包厚安和門衛老何。
    白林三十九歲，包厚安十八歲，老何不知年齡。雖然他說自己四十八歲，但他那滿頭白髮實在無法讓人相信。
    桌上放著今天的報紙，一個醒目而奇怪的標題引起了包厚安的注意——“抓藏花，賞千金。”他拿起報紙，仔細讀起來。
    原來這是一個懸賞公告。
    發公告的人叫高右年，是上海有名的大商人。公告裡說高右年家珍藏的珠寶被一個叫藏花的小偷偷走了，只要有人能幫高右年抓住這個小偷、追回被偷的珠寶，高右年就會給他一千元作為賞金。公告的下面還有一張案發現場的照片，是一個空房間。
    “藏花——有意思的名字。”包厚安說。
    “有興趣？那去抓住他！一千元可是大獎！”老何吃著餅說。
    包厚安搖頭說：“這種事情應該去警察局報警，而不是在報紙上發懸賞公告。”
    老何吃了一口餅，說：“你怎麼知道他們沒報警？如果警察抓得到，那還要我們偵探社做什麼？”
    包厚安沒有說話，他看著報紙，不知道在想什麼。
    “怎麼樣，有興趣了嗎？”老何問。
    包厚安點了點頭。
    “我就說吧！你看我們這辦公樓又舊又破！早就該好好修整一下了！一千元可以做很多事啊！”老何興奮地說。
    “我有興趣的不是賞金。”包厚安指著公告下面的照片說：“你看，放珠寶的這個房間只有一個門。小偷偷走了珠寶，但門鎖沒有被破壞，他是怎麼進入房間的呢？”
    老何看了看，說：“小偷拿到了門鎖的鑰匙？”
    包厚安搖頭：“公告裡說，門鎖只有一把鑰匙，鑰匙只有高右年才有。他把鑰匙放在枕頭下面，珠寶被偷走的那個晚上，鑰匙一直在枕頭下面。”
    “那小偷是怎麼做到的？”老何好奇地問。
    包厚安說：“只有兩種可能，一種是小偷從枕頭下面拿到了鑰匙，偷走珠寶後又還了回來，高右年睡著了，沒有發現鑰匙被拿走過。”
    “有道理，但既然已經拿到珠寶了，為什麼還要還鑰匙呢？”老何問。
    “是的，這是有些奇怪，所以我想可能還有第二種情況。”
    “什麼情況？”
    “公告裡說的不是真的。”
    “你的意思是高右年說謊了？他為什麼要說謊？”老何有點兒不敢相信。
    “我也不知道，這個問題只有高右年才能回答。”

sentences.traditional: “有道理，但既然已經拿到珠寶了，為什麼還要還鑰匙呢？”老何問。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu dào li dàn jì rán yǐ jīng ná dào zhū bǎo le wèi shén me hái yào huán yào shi ne lǎo hé wèn
sentences.english: “Makes sense. But why return the key when you’ve already gotten the jewels?” Old He asked.

sentences.simplified: “是的，这是有些奇怪，所以我想可能还有第二种情况。”
sentences.traditional: “是的，這是有些奇怪，所以我想可能還有第二種情況。”
sentences.pinyin: shì de zhè shì yǒu xiē qí guài suǒ yǐ wǒ xiǎng kě néng hái yǒu dì èr zhǒng qíng kuàng
sentences.english: “Yes, this is a little strange. So I thought it might be the second situation.”

sentences.simplified: “什么情况？”
sentences.traditional: “什麼情況？”
sentences.pinyin: shén me qíng kuàng
sentences.english: “What situation?”

sentences.simplified: “公告里说的不是真的。”
sentences.traditional: “公告裡說的不是真的。”
sentences.pinyin: gōng gào lǐ shuō de bú shì zhēn de
sentences.english: “What the notice says is not true.”

sentences.simplified: “你的意思是高右年说谎了？他为什么要说谎？”老何有点儿不敢相信。
sentences.traditional: “你的意思是高右年說謊了？他為什麼要說謊？”老何有點兒不敢相信。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ de yì si shì gāo yòu nián shuō huǎng le tā wèi shén me yào shuō huǎng lǎo hé yǒu diǎn'r bù gǎn xiāng xìn
sentences.english: “You mean Gao Younian lied? Why would he lie?” Old He was a bit incredulous.

sentences.simplified: “我也不知道，这个问题只有高右年才能回答。”
sentences.traditional: “我也不知道，這個問題只有高右年才能回答。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yě bù zhī dào zhè ge wèn tí zhǐ yǒu gāo yòu nián cái néng huí dá
sentences.english: “I don’t know. This question can only be answered by Gao Younian.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 4: Reward Notice
The Bai Lin Detective Agency was the most famous detective agency in Shanghai.
But few people knew that this famous detective agency actually consisted of only three people:
Bai Lin, the head of the agency, staff member Bao Houan, and the doorkeeper, Old He.
Bai Lin was 39, Bao Houan was 18, and Old He’s age was unknown.
Although he said he was 48 years old, his full head of white hair made it hard for anyone to believe.
Today’s newspaper was on the table. A striking and strange headline caught Bao Houan’s attention: “Catch Cang Hua, Huge Reward”.
He picked up the paper and read it carefully.
This was a reward notice.
The person who posted the notice was named Gao Younian, a famous businessman in Shanghai.
The notice said that Gao Younian’s family’s precious collection of jewels had been stolen by a thief named Cang Hua.
If anyone could help Gao Younian catch the thief and recover the stolen jewels, Gao Younian would give them 1,000 yuan as a reward.
Below the notice was another photo of the crime scene. It was an empty room.
“Cang Hua, interesting name,” said Bao Houan.
“Interested? Then go get him! 1,000 yuan is a really big reward!” Old He said as he ate dough cakes.
Bao Houan shook his head and said, “Such matters should be reported to the police station, not posted as reward notices in newspapers.”
Old He took a bite of dough cake and said, “How do you know they didn’t report it to the police?
If the police could catch him, then what would be left for our detective agency to do?”
Bao Houan didn’t say anything. He looked at the newspaper. It was unclear what was going through his mind.
“How about it, are you interested?” Old He asked.
Bao Houan nodded.
“I told you so! Look at our old and dilapidated office building!
It’s long overdue for a proper renovation! A lot could be done with 1,000 yuan!” Old He said excitedly.
“It’s not the reward I’m interested in.” Bao Houan pointed at the photo below the announcement and said, ..
.. “Look, there is only one door to this room where the jewels were kept.
The thief stole the jewels, but the door lock was not broken. So how did he enter the room?”
Old He had a look and said, “The thief got the key to the door?”
Bao Houan shook his head: “The notice says that there is only one key to the door, and only Gao Younian has it.
He kept the key under his pillow the entire night that the jewels were stolen.”
“So, how did the thief manage to do it?” Old He asked curiously.
Bao Houan said, ..
.. “There are only two possibilities. One is that the thief got the key from under the pillow, stole the jewels, and then put it back.
Gao Younian was asleep and did not discover that the key had been taken.”
“Makes sense. But why return the key when you’ve already gotten the jewels?” Old He asked.
“Yes, this is a little strange. So I thought it might be the second situation.”
“What situation?”
“What the notice says is not true.”
“You mean Gao Younian lied? Why would he lie?” Old He was a bit incredulous.
“I don’t know. This question can only be answered by Gao Younian.”
